name: sky_dome_tessellate
describe: Fixed sky-plane grid tessellation: over k,l in [-384,384] step 64 (13x13 cells), emit 4 quad-corner vertices each at a constant Y plane. reverseX swaps the X edges (generateSky2 path). PURE deterministic geometry; only the GL/VertexBuffer emit is removed. All coords are exact integers cast through float/double, so the only trap is Java's cast points.
